autoApproveDevelopers.description_en: Specifies whether to automatically approve developer registration requests
autoApproveDevelopers.description_zh: 是否自动审批开发者注册申请

autoApproveSubscriptions.description_en: Specifies whether to automatically approve API subscription requests
autoApproveSubscriptions.description_zh: 是否自动审批 API 订阅请求

builtinAuthEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether to enable username and password authentication (built-in authentication)
builtinAuthEnabled.description_zh: 是否启用账号密码认证（内置认证）

description_en: Performs a paged query for the list of HiMarket developer portals under the current tenant. Each list item in the paging result returns the portal ID, portal name, portal description, region ID, portal settings, and portal domain configurations
description_zh: 分页查询当前租户下的 HiMarket 开发者门户列表，每个列表项返回门户 ID、Portal 名称、Portal 描述、地域 ID、Portal 配置与 Portal 域名配置
kebab_example: aliyun apig list-portals --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --name developer-portal --max-results 10 --next-token next-token-xxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPortals

parameters.help_en: The portal name, which is the Name property of the portal resource. This corresponds to the name field in the response list items
parameters.help_zh: Portal 名称，即门户资源 Portal 的 Name 属性，与响应列表项中的 name 为同一字段
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per request
parameters.help_zh: 每次请求返回的最大条目数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next page
parameters.help_zh: 下一页查询的游标令牌
parameters.name: next_token

content.description_en: The list of portals. The list element is named portalConfig, and each element contains the information of a HiMarket developer portal
content.description_zh: 门户列表，列表元素名为 portalConfig，每个元素为一个 HiMarket 开发者门户的信息

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 (RFC 3339) format in the UTC time zone, such as 2026-05-15T10:00:00Z
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，格式为 ISO 8601（RFC 3339），UTC 时区，例如 2026-05-15T10:00:00Z

description.description_en: The portal description, which is the Description property of the portal resource
description.description_zh: Portal 描述，即门户资源 Portal 的 Description 属性
description.example: 面向内部开发者的 HiMarket 门户

name.description_en: The portal name, which is the Name property of the portal resource
name.description_zh: Portal 名称，即门户资源 Portal 的 Name 属性

portalDomainConfig.description_en: The list of portal domain configurations. The list element is named domainConfig
portalDomainConfig.description_zh: Portal 域名配置列表，列表元素名为 domainConfig

items.description_en: The details of a single portal domain configuration, including the domain name, request protocol, and domain name type
items.description_zh: 单条 Portal 域名配置详情，包含域名、请求协议与域名类型

portalId.description_en: The portal ID, which is the primary ID of the portal resource. It can be used in GetPortal, UpdatePortal, and DeletePortal to locate the portal at /himarket/v1/portals/{portalId}
portalId.description_zh: 门户 ID，即门户资源 Portal 的一级 ID，可用于 GetPortal、UpdatePortal、DeletePortal 以 /himarket/v1/portals/{portalId} 定位该门户

portalSettingConfig.description_en: The portal configuration, including whether username and password authentication is enabled, whether developer registrations are automatically approved, and whether subscription requests are automatically approved
portalSettingConfig.description_zh: Portal 配置信息，包含是否启用账号密码认证、是否自动审批开发者注册、是否自动审批订阅请求

regionId.description_en: The region ID, which corresponds to the RegionId property of the portal resource
regionId.description_zh: 地域 ID，对应门户资源 Portal 的 RegionId 属性

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned in this request
maxResults.description_zh: 本次请求返回的最大条目数

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页查询的游标令牌
